opening.line1: The night has lasted a hundred years.
opening.line2: Everyone forgot what morning looks like.

seed.line1: Every morning starts with something small.
seed.gatherHint: Drag the moon lantern through the drifting sparks — on mobile, touch & drag.

memories.title: The Rooftops
memories.text: The antennas catch it first and pass it down, dish to dish, like gossip.

memories.title: The Harbor
memories.text: The waves rehearse the sunrise until they get it exactly right.

memories.title: The Wheat Field
memories.text: Every stalk turns at once, like an audience spotting the guest of honor.

memories.title: The Hospital Window
memories.text: Someone who barely slept watches the light arrive — and decides to stay for it.

memories.title: The Kitchen Table
memories.text: Two cups. One sunrise. The day, still unwritten, steaming quietly between you.

memoryHearts: Keys. A door. Somewhere to be.

reasons: Because even the dark gets tired.
Because dreams need somewhere to land.
Because the birds filed a complaint.
Because you stayed up for it.
whyYou.gathered: Every answer rises into one sun.

letter.pre1: The night left something before it went…
lines: I held the sky as long as I could,
Take care of the sleepy ones.
Go easy on the east windows.
that is where the day is decided.
I will be back at dusk.

nightSky.line1: The last stars are packing up…

heartbeat.reveal2: That is the day, stretching awake.

finalJourney: There is one thing the morning wants you to know.

finale.line1: No matter how long the night…
